requirement.requirement_text: The system runs on demand: it starts manually, or optionally when a new client row is added to a Google Sheets queue. Inputs: client configuration and sector guidance; source evidence documents stored in Google Drive; and Google Sheets data containing RACI, tools inventory, KPI snapshot, and benchmarks. The system shall: (1) load the client configuration and sector guidance, download the source evidence from Google Drive, and read the RACI, tools inventory, KPI snapshot, and benchmarks from Google Sheets; (2) normalize and score the collected evidence into a single structured current-state dataset with basic data-quality signals; (3) use a language model to analyze inefficiencies and generate AI/automation recommendations aligned to the selected sector and compliance needs; (4) use a language model to generate a future-state target operating model (org design, technology architecture, roadmap, and a new RACI) and calculate cautious/hybrid/aggressive ROI scenarios; (5) build Mermaid diagrams and generate an executive transformation report plus an internal consultant rationale, then assemble a final payload. Visible outcomes: the structured outputs (models, recommendations, RACI, diagrams, audit summary, executive summary, KPI benchmarking/projections) are written to Google Sheets, and a consolidated text report is uploaded to Google Drive. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.
